const express = require('express');
const helmet = require('helmet');
const cors = require('cors');
const bodyParser = require('body-parser');
const jwt = require('jsonwebtoken');
const bcrypt = require('bcrypt');
const { Pool } = require('pg');
const http = require('http');
const { Server } = require('socket.io');
require('dotenv').config();

const app = express();
app.use(helmet());
app.use(cors());
app.use(bodyParser.json());

const pool = new Pool({ connectionString: process.env.DATABASE_URL });

// Simple DOB validator: returns true if age >= 18
function isAdult(dobString) {
  const dob = new Date(dobString);
  if (Number.isNaN(dob.getTime())) return false;
  const diff = Date.now() - dob.getTime();
  const ageDt = new Date(diff);
  return Math.abs(ageDt.getUTCFullYear() - 1970) >= 18;
}

// Register endpoint (simplified)
app.post('/api/auth/register', async (req, res) => {
  const { email, password, name, dob } = req.body;
  if (!email || !password || !dob) return res.status(400).json({ message: 'Missing fields' });
  if (!isAdult(dob)) return res.status(403).json({ message: 'Must be 18+' });

  const hashed = await bcrypt.hash(password, 10);
  try {
    const { rows } = await pool.query(
      'INSERT INTO users (email, password, name, dob) VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4) RETURNING id, email, name',
      [email, hashed, name || null, dob]
    );
    const user = rows[0];
    const token = jwt.sign({ sub: user.id }, process.env.JWT_SECRET, { expiresIn: process.env.JWT_EXPIRES_IN });
    res.status(201).json({ user, token });
  } catch (err) {
    console.error(err);
    res.status(500).json({ message: 'Server error' });
  }
});

// Basic server + socket setup
const server = http.createServer(app);
const io = new Server(server, { cors: { origin: '*' } });

io.use((socket, next) => {
  const token = socket.handshake.auth?.token;
  if (!token) return next(new Error('Authentication error'));
  try {
    const payload = jwt.verify(token, process.env.JWT_SECRET);
    socket.userId = payload.sub;
    next();
  } catch (err) {
    next(new Error('Authentication error'));
  }
});

io.on('connection', (socket) => {
  console.log('socket connected', socket.userId);
  socket.join(`user:${socket.userId}`);
  socket.on('private_message', (data) => {
    // save to DB + emit to recipient
    io.to(`user:${data.toUserId}`).emit('private_message', { from: socket.userId, message: data.message });
  });
});

const port = process.env.PORT || 4000;
server.listen(port, () => console.log(`Backend running on ${port}`));

Pulse is an open-source social networking and dating platform built with Laravel (backend), React (web), and React Native (mobile). Pulse provides the building blocks for creating privacy-focused community and dating apps with real-time messaging, discovery, and moderation tools.

## Features
- Email/OAuth authentication and profile management
- Matching & discovery (swipe deck + algorithmic feed)
- Real-time 1:1 chat with push notifications
- Posts, comments, likes, and follower/following model
- Moderation tools (reporting, blocking, admin dashboard)
- Monetization support (subscriptions, in-app purchases)
- Extensible REST/GraphQL API

## Tech stack
- Backend: Laravel 10+, PHP 8.1+
- Web: React + TypeScript, Vite
- Mobile: React Native / Expo
- Database: MySQL / PostgreSQL
- Realtime: Laravel WebSockets or Pusher
- Storage: AWS S3 (or S3-compatible)
- Push: Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM)
- CI/CD: GitHub Actions, Fastlane for Play Store

## Quick start (developer)
1. Clone the repo:
   ```
   git clone https://github.com/<owner>/pulse.git
   cd pulse
   ```

2. Backend (Laravel)
   - Copy `.env.example` → `.env` and set DB and storage credentials
   - Install dependencies:
     ```
     composer install
     php artisan key:generate
     ```
   - Run migrations & seeders:
     ```
     php artisan migrate --seed
     ```
   - Start local server:
     ```
     php artisan serve
     ```

3. Web frontend (React)
   - Open `frontend/`:
     ```
     cd frontend
     npm install
     npm run dev
     ```

4. Mobile (React Native / Expo)
   - Open `mobile/`:
     ```
     cd mobile
     npm install
     # For Expo:
     expo start
     # For bare RN: follow Android build steps (React Native docs)
     ```

5. Docker (optional)
   - Use `docker-compose` for a full local dev stack:
     ```
     docker-compose up --build
     ```

This repository contains a minimal starter script for a dating/social application:
- Backend: Laravel 10+ (API) with Sanctum token auth
- Frontend: React (Vite) minimal client
- Local dev: Docker Compose (PHP-FPM + Nginx + MySQL)

Quick start (docker)
1. Copy .env files:
   - backend/.env.example → backend/.env
   - frontend: create .env with FRONTEND_API_URL
2. Build and run:
   ```
   docker-compose up --build -d
   ```
3. Install backend deps (inside container or locally):
   ```
   docker exec -it pulse_backend php -r "copy('https://getcomposer.org/installer', 'composer-setup.php');"
   docker exec -it pulse_backend composer install
   docker exec -it pulse_backend php artisan key:generate
   docker exec -it pulse_backend php artisan migrate --seed
   ```
4. Install frontend deps and run dev (or build):
   ```
   cd frontend
   npm install
   npm run dev
   ```

- API endpoints (see backend/routes/api.php) for:
  - POST /api/register
  - POST /api/login
  - POST /api/logout
  - GET /api/profile/{id}
  - PUT /api/profile
  - GET /api/matches
  - POST /api/chat/messages

Extending
- Add WebSockets (Laravel WebSockets or Pusher) for real-time chat.
- Implement swipe UI, mutual matches, notifications, and media uploads (S3).
- Add admin dashboard, moderation, and payment integration.

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use App\Models\User;
use App\Models\Profile;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Hash;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;

class AuthController extends Controller
{
    public function register(Request $request)
    {
        $data = $request->validate([
            'email' => 'required|email|unique:users',
            'password' => 'required|min:6',
            'name' => 'nullable|string'
        ]);

        $user = User::create([
            'email' => $data['email'],
            'name' => $data['name'] ?? null,
            'password' => Hash::make($data['password']),
        ]);

        // create empty profile
        $user->profile()->create();

        $token = $user->createToken('api-token')->plainTextToken;

        return response()->json(['user' => $user, 'token' => $token], 201);
    }

    public function login(Request $request)
    {
        $data = $request->validate([
            'email'=>'required|email',
            'password'=>'required'
        ]);

        $user = User::where('email', $data['email'])->first();

        if (! $user || ! Hash::check($data['password'], $user->password)) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['email' => ['Invalid credentials']]);
        }

        $token = $user->createToken('api-token')->plainTextToken;

        return response()->json(['user' => $user, 'token' => $token]);
    }

    public function logout(Request $request)
    {
        $request->user()->currentAccessToken()->delete();
        return response()->json(['message' => 'logged out']);
    }
}

    {

    {
        $user = $request->user();
        $data = $request->validate([

            'gender' => 'nullable|string',
            'age' => 'nullable|integer',
            'location' => 'nullable|string',
            'interests' => 'nullable|array',
        ]);

        $profile = $user->profile;
        $profile->update($data);

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use App\Models\Profile;

class MatchController extends Controller
{
    public function index(Request $request)
    {
        // Very basic matching: return other profiles ordered by id desc.
        // Replace with distance / interests / algorithm later.
        $userId = $request->user()->id;

        $profiles = Profile::with('user')
            ->where('user_id', '!=', $userId)
            ->orderBy('id', 'desc')
            ->take(20)
            ->get();

        return response()->json($profiles);
    }
}

    {
        $data = $request->validate([
            'to_user_id' => 'required|integer',
            'message' => 'required|string',
        ]);

        // Very small messages table using DB facade for brevity.
        $id = DB::table('messages')->insertGetId([
            'from_user_id' => $request->user()->id,
            'to_user_id' => $data['to_user_id'],
            'message' => $data['message'],
            'created_at' => now(),
            'updated_at' => now()
        ]);

        $message = DB::table('messages')->where('id', $id)->first();

        return response()->json($message, 201);
    }
}
